title: Manager, Product Management, Scheme and Regulatory Compliance
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Product Management, Scheme and Regulatory ComplianceOverview  
  
Mastercard Gateway, formerly known as MPGS, operates at the centre of the global payments ecosystem and supports customers across more than 70 countries. As an agnostic gateway serving acquirers, merchants, and partners globally, Mastercard Gateway must continuously respond to payment scheme mandates, regional regulatory requirements, and internal Mastercard compliance obligations.  
  
From a Gateway Scheme Compliance perspective, this role is critical to ensuring that scheme and regulatory changes are identified early, assessed accurately, prioritized effectively, and delivered within mandated timelines. The role supports the translation of scheme communications, announcements, bulletin into clear business impact assessments, product roadmap priorities, execution plans, and stakeholder communications that help reduce financial, operational, reputational risk.  
This role also supports gateway customers to gain benefit via reduced scheme fees, higher approval rates, and enable new MC product and services.
  
  
Role  
  
Reporting to the Director of Scheme Compliance, the role holder will support the Product Compliance function for the Mastercard Gateway product suite. The primary objective is to strengthen MPGS readiness for scheme mandates and regulatory obligations by driving disciplined intake, impact assessment, prioritization, governance, and execution tracking across the product lifecycle.  
  
The role will scan and analyse card scheme rules, bulletins, announcements, and mandates, assess applicability to MPGS, and convert these inputs into actionable roadmap items, compliance requirements, customer-impact assessments, and delivery priorities.  
The role will manage the collection, assessment, and prioritization of scheme compliance initiatives across Gateway, working closely with Global Product Management, Regional Product teams, Product Management-Technical, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Customer-facing teams. The role will also support governance forums and PI Planning inputs to ensure compliance priorities are visible, understood, and reflected in delivery plans.  
  
The Compliance Product team is responsible for maintaining a structured relationship with Payment Schemes, including Mastercard, Visa, Amex, and other relevant networks, for receiving, analysing, clarifying, and operationalizing scheme bulletins and mandates.  
  
In addition, the role holder will support internal and external communication, training, and readiness activities for stakeholders and customers impacted by scheme or regulatory changes.  
  
Responsibilities  
  
Analyse card scheme communications, mandates, bulletins, and regulatory updates to identify applicability, business impact, customer impact, delivery risk, and compliance deadlines for Mastercard Gateway.  
Provide clear summaries of scheme rule changes and translate them into actionable requirements for impacted Gateway business areas.  
Partner with Product, PMT, Region, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Customer-facing teams to ensure required changes are prioritized and delivered within mandated timelines.  
Support roadmap planning and SAFe PI or Kanban Planning by ensuring scheme compliance priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines are clearly represented in delivery plans.  
Maintain a central repository of scheme communications, impact assessments, decisions, evidence, and delivery status for auditability and transparency.  
Build and maintain internal portals, trackers, and communication channels for scheme compliance updates and mandate visibility.  
Define, document, and continuously improve internal processes for scheme compliance intake, triage, assessment, governance, escalation, and closure with end to end ownership.  
Support MPGS business areas with scheme-related queries, clarifications, and interpretation of scheme requirements.  
Prepare internal and external communications, training material, customer readiness updates, and implementation guidance for impacted stakeholders.  
Liaise with payment networks and schemes where applicable to clarify requirements, represent MPGS considerations, and advocate appropriate Mastercard or customer positions.  
Identify and escalate compliance gaps, delivery risks, financial exposure, and customer impacts in a timely manner, with recommended remediation and communication plans.  
Use and bring AI efficiency in day-to-day work and in the compliance process which will add benefit to the Gateway and customers.
  
  
All About You  
  
8+ years of experience in Product Management, Payments, Scheme Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, Gateway products, Acquiring business, Merchant services, or related payments domains.  
Strong understanding of card schemes authorization & clearing modules, payment gateways, acquirers, merchants, acquiring banks, ecommerce, card present, digital and token payment flows.  
Experience interpreting scheme rules, mandates, bulletins, compliance requirements, and regulatory updates, with the ability to convert them into clear product requirement and delivery actions.  
Experience working with agile and Kanban delivery models, ideally including SAFe, PI Planning, backlog prioritization, dependency management, and cross-team execution tracking.  
Ability to build effective relationships across Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Regional, Commercial, Sales, Support, and Customer-facing teams.  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess business impact, delivery complexity, financial exposure, reputational risk, and customer implications.  
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across global teams and time zones.  
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex scheme requirements for both technical and business audiences.  
Self-organized, self-driven with E2E ownership mindset, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced global payments environment with evolving priorities and strict compliance deadlines.  
Knowledge on AI tools, AI agents and application like Aha, Confluence, Jira is essential.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Advocate
description:
A junior advocate in a revenue and land law practice acts as the backbone of the legal team. They are responsible for conducting title searches, verifying land titles, preparing legal opinions, and researching case precedents to support senior counsel in revenue courts and tribunals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. Title Search & Due Diligence**

* **Document Verification:** Investigating the chain of custody for land titles by examining property deeds, encumbrance certificates, and partition deeds.
* **Revenue Records:** Pulling and verifying land records like 7\12 extracts, Khata certificates, and mutation registers from local municipal or village revenue offices (Talathi/Tehsildar offices).
* **Report Generation:** Drafting formal Title Search Reports and Legal Scrutiny Reports outlining any encumbrances, liens, or legal defects on a property.

**2. Legal Research & Case Preparation**

* **Precedent Research:** Analyzing judicial opinions from the Supreme Court, High Courts, and Revenue Tribunals to identify relevant precedents for ongoing disputes.
* **Statutory Interpretation:** Researching complex state-specific revenue acts (e.g., Maharashtra Land Revenue Code, Bombay Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act).

**3. Drafting & Documentation**

* **Pleadings:** Assisting senior advocates in drafting petitions, appeals, revisions, and writ petitions to be filed before the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO), District Collector, Revenue Tribunals, or High Courts.
* **Transactional Documents:** Drafting non-litigation revenue documents such as title deeds, sale agreements, and powers of attorney.

**4. Court & Administrative Coordination**

* **Registry Follow-ups:** Managing e-filings, tracking case statuses, and handling procedural follow-ups with court or tribunal registries.
* **Client Communication:** Acting as the bridge between clients, senior counsel, and revenue officers, ensuring a seamless flow of case information.
* To succeed in this domain, juniors are highly encouraged to familiarize themselves with official state portals like the National Generic Documents Registration System (NGDRS) and local government property registries to efficiently perform title searches.]

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Indirect Tax
description:
**Job Purpose:**

  

To manage and oversee all GST and indirect tax litigation matters of the organization, including handling show-cause notices, departmental audits, investigations, appeals, hearings, and coordination with legal counsels and consultants. The role is responsible for minimizing tax exposure, ensuring timely compliance with litigation requirements, and maintaining complete litigation records across locations.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**GST Litigation Management**

* Independently handle GST litigation matters across India.

* Draft, review, and submit replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), notices, summons, and departmental communications.

* Prepare and file appeals before appellate authorities, tribunals, and other judicial forums.

* Analyze litigation risks and develop defense strategies in consultation with internal stakeholders and legal advisors.

* Track all ongoing GST disputes, investigations, assessments, and appeals.

  
  

**Representation and Hearings**

* Attend hearings before GST authorities and appellate forums.

* Coordinate with advocates, counsels, and consultants for litigation strategy and representation.

* Prepare briefs, supporting documents, factual summaries, and legal submissions for hearings.

* Ensure timely compliance related to Litigations with directions issued by authorities.

  
  

**Advisory and Technical Support**

* Research GST laws, notifications, circulars, advance rulings, and judicial pronouncements.

* Provide technical guidance to Tax Compliance Team, business and finance teams on GST implications and dispute resolution.

* Identify potential tax risks and recommend corrective actions.

  
  

**Coordination with Internal & External Stakeholders**

* Liaise with external tax consultants, law firms, and counsels.

Manage relationships with GST authorities and government departments.

* Manage & Co-ordinate with Tax Compliance Team within Organisation

* Coordinate with internal compliance departments for collection of information and documentation required for litigation matters.

  
  

**Litigation Tracking and MIS**

* Maintain a centralized litigation tracker covering all states and GST registrations.

* Monitor litigation timelines, hearing schedules, appeal deadlines, and compliance requirements.

* Prepare periodic MIS reports for senior management regarding litigation status, tax exposure, and key developments.

  
  

**Contingent Liability Management**

* Maintain complete documentation relating to tax disputes and contingent liabilities.

* Support statutory auditors, internal auditors, and management in assessing litigation provisions and contingent liability disclosures.

* Ensure proper documentation and record retention for all litigation matters.

  
  

**Audit and Investigation Support**

* Handle GST departmental audits, investigations, and assessments.

* Coordinate responses to audit observations and queries.

* Support closure of audit objections and disputes.

  
  

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong practical knowledge of GST litigation and indirect tax laws.

* Expertise in drafting legal submissions, replies, and appeals.

* Experience handling departmental audits, investigations, and assessments.

• Ability to interpret legal provisions and judicial precedents. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and litigation tracking systems.

* Ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines simultaneously.

  
  

**Basic Qulaification:**

  

* Minimum 5–10 years of experience in indirect taxation with substantial exposure to GST litigation.

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with Strong knowledge of GST laws, rules, notifications, circulars, and judicial precedents

* Proven experience in handling SCNs, appeals, hearings, departmental audits, and assessments.

* Experience managing litigation matters across multiple states.

* Ability to work independently and interact with senior management, auditors, consultants, and government authorities.

  

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Critical Thinking, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Influencing Without Authority, Problem Solving, Tax Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO** **SITA**  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. **ABOUT THE ROLE \& TEAM**  

The Legal Resources Hub collaborates with legal teams across SITA to deliver legal services, standardize selected areas of work, and accelerate key projects.  

The role will support a broad range of legal matters including customer contract drafting and negotiation, third\-party due diligence, corporate legal support, management of SITA’s telecommunications regulatory portfolio, intellectual property, legal research, and other legal matters. **SITA Lawyers as Navigators:**  

* Navigating the complexity of rules \& regulations and the turbulence of unwanted risks and liabilities. Keeping us proud of what SITA does
* Suggesting ways to avoid the biggest bumps and scrapes
* Sharing the burden of making informed decisions and ensuring SITA comes to safe landings.
* Keeping us proud of what SITA does

* Getting our products to market across the world – global products, delivered everywhere

* Pulling together the work of many into contracts, documents and governance that tell the deal as it is: understandable, practical, useful and clear
 **WHAT YOU’LL DO*** Engage and Encourage: Work with the existing LRH team to bring out their best work and support their professional development and experience building.
* Lead and Supervise: Serve as the primary point of contact for the team, providing guidance and support while ensuring high\-quality deliverables, effective quality assurance, and meaningful value addition to the business.
* Lead the Market Facing Work : Ensure that contract review and negotiation, due diligence and other engagement with internal and external clients and partners is fast, effective and commercially compelling
* Drive our digital and AI programs: as SITA moves to manage customer contracts in an iCertis portal and seeks to leverage the benefit of AI, this role needs to be fully engaged and embedded in our AI transformation of legal work

  


Qualifications:

* Driven \& Accountable: Ambitious, proactive, and committed to taking ownership and delivering results.
* People\-Centric: Inspire and motivate others by setting a clear vision, objectives, and fostering pride in the work.
* Enterprise\-Minded: Make sound decisions and provide advice aligned with the company’s strategic vision and financial guardrails.
* Analytical \& Solutions\-Oriented: Thrive in ambiguity, challenge assumptions, identify problems quickly, and develop data\-driven solutions.
* Curious, Courageous \& Collaborative: Open to feedback and different perspectives, communicate effectively at all levels, and have the confidence to ask and address tough questions.
* More than 10 years of diverse, hands\-on legal experience, including commercial contract drafting and negotiation.
* Strong understanding of legal governance and broader corporate legal matters.
* Genuine interest in technology and emerging legal tech, particularly the use of AI to enhance Legal operations and decision\-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex issues into clear, concise, and compelling messages.
* A pragmatic, business\-oriented approach with a focus on delivering practical legal solutions
* Experience being a lead lawyer in one or more domains (a domain being a BU, a Geography/Region, a specific area of Law or legal practice)

 **WHAT WE OFFER**We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

title: Manager - Legal, Compliance & Company Secretarial
description:
Skechers India is looking for a qualified Lawyer and Company Secretary to join the Legal function as Manager – Legal, Compliance \& Company Secretarial. The role will provide comprehensive legal and governance support to the business across contracts, regulatory compliance, litigation, intellectual property, company secretarial matters, and other legal requirements.  

The role will work closely with internal business functions, senior stakeholders, external legal counsel, and regulatory authorities to ensure that business activities are supported by appropriate legal documentation, sound compliance practices, and effective governance processes.**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Legal Advisory \& Contract Management**

* Draft, review, negotiate and provide legal inputs on a wide range of commercial and business agreements.
* Handle and review **lease agreements, Leave \& License agreements, vendor agreements, customer agreements, service agreements, NDAs, and other commercial contracts**.
* Identify contractual risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures while protecting the Company's interests.
* Monitor key contractual obligations, renewals, notices, and compliance requirements under executed agreements.
* Provide timely legal advice to business functions on day\-to\-day operational and commercial matters.
* Research applicable laws, regulations and judicial developments and prepare legal opinions and recommendations.

**2\. Regulatory Compliance**

* Support the Company in identifying, interpreting, and implementing applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Advise internal stakeholders on legal and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to business operations.
* Coordinate with relevant functions to track and address compliance requirements across the organization.
* Support compliance requirements relating to corporate operations, retail stores, offices, sourcing/manufacturing activities, and other business operations, as applicable.
* Monitor regulatory developments and communicate relevant changes to stakeholders.
* **Legal Metrology** experience and exposure will be an added advantage.

**3\. Litigation \& Dispute Management**

* Coordinate and assist in managing litigation, notices, claims, disputes, and other legal proceedings.
* Liaise with external lawyers and legal counsel on ongoing and potential litigation matters.
* Support preparation of case briefs, legal responses, documentation, and other information required for legal proceedings.
* Maintain appropriate records and trackers for litigation and legal matters.
* Provide timely updates to relevant stakeholders on significant legal matters and associated risks.

**4\. Intellectual Property Rights**

* Support the Company's **IPR and brand protection** initiatives, including trademarks and other intellectual property matters.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel on trademark, infringement, opposition, and other IPR\-related matters.
* Assist in addressing unauthorized use of the Company's brand, trademarks, and other intellectual property.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and records relating to IPR matters.

**5\. Company Secretarial \& Corporate Governance**

* Provide support to the Company Secretary in corporate governance and secretarial matters.
* Assist in preparation and coordination of **Board / Committee meetings, agendas, notices, minutes, resolutions, and related documentation**, as required.
* Support statutory filings, registers, records, and other corporate secretarial requirements.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders for timely completion of governance\-related activities.
* Support compliance with applicable provisions of the Companies Act and other relevant corporate laws.
* Assist in managing key stakeholder communication relating to governance and secretarial matters.

**6\. Data Privacy \& Emerging Legal Areas**

* Support the organization in understanding and implementing applicable **data privacy and protection requirements**.
* Review relevant business processes and agreements from a data privacy and legal risk perspective.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders on privacy\-related requirements, contractual provisions, and compliance initiatives.
* Exposure to applicable data privacy laws and their practical implementation will be an added advantage.

**7\. Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Finance, HR, Procurement, Retail, Operations, Sourcing, IT, Marketing, and other business functions to provide timely legal support.
* Liaise effectively with external lawyers, consultants, vendors, government/regulatory authorities, and other external stakeholders.
* Provide practical, business\-oriented legal guidance while ensuring appropriate risk management.
* Conduct legal and compliance awareness sessions / training for business teams and relevant stakeholders.

**8\. Reporting \& Documentation**

* Prepare and submit periodic reports and updates to the Head of Legal / reporting manager.
* Maintain appropriate trackers for contracts, litigation, compliance, IPR and other legal matters.
* Ensure timely escalation of material legal, regulatory, or contractual risks.
* Maintain confidentiality and integrity of sensitive legal and business information.

 **Educational Qualification**

* **LL.B. / Bachelor of Law – Mandatory**
* **Company Secretary (CS) – Mandatory**
* Additional legal / compliance qualifications will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **8–12 years of relevant post\-qualification experience** in legal, compliance and/or company secretarial functions.
* Experience in **retail, consumer, FMCG, e\-commerce or other consumer\-facing businesses** will be preferred.
* Strong exposure to commercial contract drafting and review is required.
* Experience in handling legal, regulatory, litigation, IPR and company secretarial matters.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of commercial contracts and legal documentation.
* Good understanding of applicable corporate and commercial laws.
* Exposure to statutory and regulatory compliance management.
* Knowledge of litigation and dispute management processes.
* Understanding of intellectual property / trademark matters.
* Working knowledge of Company Secretarial and corporate governance requirements.
* Familiarity with data privacy laws and their business application will be an advantage.
* Exposure to Legal Metrology regulations will be an advantage.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong legal drafting and contract review skills.
* Sound analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Strong attention to detail and risk orientation.
* Ability to interpret legislation and translate legal requirements into practical business advice.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional judgment.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic business environment.

 **Key Success Areas**


The incumbent will be expected to contribute to:

* Effective and timely legal support to business functions.
* Robust contract review and risk mitigation.
* Timely management of litigation and external legal counsel.
* Effective regulatory and legal compliance.
* Protection of Skechers' intellectual property and brand interests.
* Strong corporate governance and company secretarial support.
* Increased legal and compliance awareness across business teams.
* Timely identification and escalation of legal and regulatory risks.

 **Why Join Skechers India?**


This role offers an opportunity to work closely with a growing, consumer\-facing organization and gain broad exposure across **commercial legal, compliance, litigation, intellectual property, corporate governance, and company secretarial matters** while partnering with multiple business functions across India.

**About Skechers**


Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Counsel 1 - Legal (Product) - Officer, Hybrid
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Counsel I is an entry level position responsible for providing legal guidance and thought leadership to the business. The overall objective of this role is to provide legal support, advice, and guidance to the business.

  

  

This role requires a pragmatic, proactive attorney with thorough understanding of the Business, combined with a solid conceptual / practical grounding in the laws and regulations for the geographies in which we operate. Provides input into strategic decisions, exercising sound legal judgement to develop proactive, risk\-appropriate, and commercially practical business\-oriented solutions.


### **Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for supporting team in providing legal guidance to the Business, participating in strategic initiatives, providing interpretations of relevant laws, rules, regulations, and industry practices, and advising on legal matters impacting the business
* Supports team in the evaluation of business proposals by managing and maintaining documentation according to document preservation and retention laws, applies institutional knowledge and risk appetite against industry standards, widely accepted business practices, laws, rules, and regulatory guidelines, escalating as appropriate
* Collaborates with team and external counsel on routine operative needs to achieve coordinated and efficient outcomes on matters of common interest, coordinates closely with the Legal team on a regional and global basis
* Supports team in the management of legal, regulatory, and reputational risk by following relevant legal developments, participating in internal projects, escalating as appropriate
* Timely negotiation and preparation of ISDA Master Agreement, Global Master Repurchase Agreement, Global Master Securities Lending Agreement, CDEA and other markets trading documentation; negotiation of ancillary trading documentation, including review of corporate documentation, security and collateral documentation.
* Conduct due diligence to determine whether agreements are enforceable and meet the well\-founded basis standard under applicable capital rules.
* Coordination and tracking of deviation approvals including compliance of documentation with legal, regulatory requirements and Citi policies.
* Legal support, advice and guidance across a broad range of practice areas whilst appropriately assessing risk of business decisions made by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations and adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Management of data inputting for trading documentation and interaction with other regional support teams regarding trading documentation data systems and related queries, amendments.
* Participation in global documentation regulatory and remediation projects
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
  

  

### **Qualifications:**


* 0\-2 years of relevant industry experience, preferably in financial services
* Banking or financial industry experience, including laws related to banking regulations
* Knowledge of international laws, regulations and practices while staying abreast of regulatory and legal environment, internal policies and industry trends that impact the business
* Experience with complex deals, demonstrated ability to analyze issues and develop legal solutions
* Effective communication and negotiation skills and ability to build and maintain trusted relationships
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational and relationship management skills
* Proven ability to apply sound judgement while managing assignments in a demanding, fast\-paced environment
* Bar license in good standing to practice law
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral)
* Fluency in Microsoft word.
* Teamwork and adaptability.
* A skilled negotiator who has the right attitude and can actively work with a wide range of colleagues of varying seniority in both business and support roles to respond to a broad range of needs and develop business friendly solutions to requirements while balancing compliance with multiple legal, regulatory and internal policy requirements.
* Preferably with knowledge of legal customs and practices as well as understanding of financial services industry.

title: Sr Analyst - Tax & Compliance
description:
What You'll Do:

The Senior Analyst plays a critical role in strengthening the accuracy, scalability, and AI\-enabled execution of Avalara's U.S. Backfiling operations across multiple jurisdictions. As client complexity, historical exposure, and filing volumes increase, you will ensure consistent SLA performance, reduces compliance and penalty risk, and embeds AI\-driven workflow improvements that enhance productivity and quality.


You will report to **Sr. Manager, Professional Services.**

 **How This Role Elevates Avalara**


For Customers

* You will deliver high\-accuracy, historical return filings across multiple jurisdictions, mitigating exposure to penalties, interest, and audit risk.
* You will provide clear status communication and documentation for historical periods, helping customers understand risk remediation and outcome of backfiling engagements.


For the Business

* You will Improve operational leverage by:


	+ Reduce manual effort in data preparation, reconciliation, and notice handling.
	+ Standardize backfiling status and exposure reporting.
	+ Accelerate turnaround for large historical scopes and complex corrections.
* You will Support margin and discount discipline by minimizing re\-work, return revisions, and avoidable escalations.


For the Team

* You will raise talent density through:


	+ Mentor junior analysts on backfiling standards, risk judgment, and client communication.
	+ Structured review and quality control discipline for historical returns.
	+ Sharing templates, SOPs, and AI\-enabled best practices that uplift the whole team.


For Our AI\-First Strategy

* You will embed AI tools into core backfiling workflows (data cleansing, mapping, variance analysis, exposure quantification, documentation).
* You will create measurable improvements in:


	+ Turnaround time per historical period.
	+ Accuracy and consistency across return and periods.
	+ Analyst productivity and independence.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:
**Responsibilities (Outcome\-Based Ownership)**


Own end\-to\-end preparation, filing, and quality assurance of multi\-period, multi\-jurisdiction backfiling engagements, delivering 99% accuracy and 98–100% on\-time SLA adherence for committed timelines.

* Independently manage complex reconciliations and variance analysis between client's data, prior filings, and proposed backfiled returns, leveraging strong analytical expertise to reconcile, and where required, alter or add transaction data while maintaining clear audit trails.
* Maintain a 24\-hour turnaround time for critical client escalations and compliance inquiries related to historical filings, notices, or exposure questions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of complex, historical transaction\-level data and ensure data is accurately prepared, validated, and transformed before historical returns are prepared and filed.
* Improve document and data retrieval turnaround time by 15–25% (e.g., historical invoices, exemption certificates, prior returns, rate data) using AI\-supported research, pattern recognition, and tracking tools.
* Standardize weekly backfiling status, risk, and exposure reporting using AI\-enabled formatting and summarization tools for customers, internal leaders, and adjacent teams.
* Maintain and improve SOP documentation for backfiling (data intake, reconciliation, filing, notice handling, and closeout), aligned to client contracts, jurisdictional rules, and Avalara standards.
* Provide proactive support to CAMs and Sales teams to help drive successful backfiling and remediation sales cycles, including answering scoping questions, joining key client calls when needed, and providing clear, data\-backed delivery perspectives to build customer confidence.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**


This includes:

* Embedding AI tools into:


	+ Data cleansing, enrichment, and transformation.
	+ Reconciliation and variance explanation.
	+ Historical exposure summaries and client\-ready narratives.
	+ Backfiling escalation workflows.
* Quantifying AI impact (e.g., time saved per engagement, reduction in manual review hours, improved turnaround time per historical period, fewer rework cycles).
* Applying AI responsibly while exercising, especially for compliance\-sensitive topics such as taxability, exposure estimates, and final return values.
* Sharing AI best practices (prompts, workflows, validation steps) to elevate team capability and embed them into SOPs.

**12\-Month Success Signals**


Within 12 months, the Senior Backfiling Analyst will demonstrate:

* + Sustained 99% filing accuracy across their backfiling portfolio (returns, amendments, and corrections).
	+ 98–100% performance for agreed backfiling SLAs, including during peak workload and complex multi\-state returns.
	+ 15–25% reduction in document and data retrieval turnaround time through AI\-enabled research, tracking, and templated requests.
	+ Measurable reduction in re\-work and re\-opened engagements via validation controls, better upstream scoping, and AI\-supported checks.
	+ At least one implemented AI\-driven workflow enhancement (e.g., automated variance narratives, template builders, data\-mapping accelerators) delivering quantifiable productivity gains.
	+ Documented AI and process best practices adopted across the backfiling team and incorporated into SOPs.


What You'll Need to be Successful:

Bachelor's degree in commerce, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, or related field; or MBA in Finance.

* 3–4\+ years of experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-jurisdiction return portfolios and handling compliance escalations (e.g., notices, penalty issues).
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivots, large data\-set handling) and demonstrated ability to work with complex historical transaction data to support accurate backfiling.
* Experience using AI tools to improve operational speed, quality, or scale (for example, in data analysis, documentation, or reporting workflows).


Avalara is an AI\-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards


In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

  

Health \& Wellness  

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.  

Inclusive culture and diversity  

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.  


What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.  

We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.  

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Assistant Vice President - Legal Discovery Management
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

**Job Title**
-------------


eDiscovery Operations – Sr Counsel

**Description**
---------------


Legal Discovery Management (LDM) is an internal organization within the firm's Litigation Department.


As a Senior Counsel in Legal discovery operations team you will support and facilitate the legal discovery process, including the identification, preservation, collection, review, and production of information relevant to litigation matters, regulatory inquiries, and internal investigations.


Duties will include but will not be limited to: performing custodial/data source research and identification, along with the preservation, collection, disposition, and/or secure delivery of data within pre\-defined Service Level Agreements; acting as liaison between LDM and its partners, participating in end\-to\-end eDiscovery projects and programs with a focus on process improvement; managing various projects with multiple stakeholders; coordinating project milestones and deliverables; working directly with all staff levels from analysts to senior management, and delivering results on both near\- and long\-term initiatives.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as a point\-of\-contact for legal teams, advising and coordinating discovery activities.
* Respond to and fulfill eDiscovery requests across various data sources, including but not limited to electronic communications, voice, structured and unstructured data sources.
* Coordinate the discovery lifecycle among all collaborating parties, including the firm's internal attorneys, outside counsel, vendors, and the firm's internal discovery IT group.
* Conduct early matter outreach, discovery planning, budgeting, custodian scoping, tracking, status reporting, managing to timelines and overseeing production requests.
* Coordinate with internal IT and business partners, and external vendors in support of request fulfillment, including restoration of data with appropriate chain\-of\-custody documentation, where required.
* Oversee day\-to\-day case details for certain matter types. Maintain a level of understanding of the business uses for the systems from which data is being requested and proactively address questions related to fulfilling such requests.
* Act as a liaison between the eDiscovery team and global systems and data center contacts, including but not limited to tape operations areas/data centers and third parties, to manage various legal discovery requests.
* Facilitate the flow of documents and knowledge throughout the discovery process: direct documents into the appropriate workstreams and transmit questions, answers, and information to/from the managed review vendor and internal or external counsel.
* Support the continuous improvement of eDiscovery operational processes globally, including request processing, research, preservation, collection, disposition, delivery, and control.
* Draft and/or review process management documentation, maintain organized updates and detailed matter/project notes and documentation.
* Data\-driven problem solving and decision making; manage and appropriately escalate delivery impediments, risks, issues, and changes associated with process enhancement initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
-----------------------------------------------------




* Law Graduate / J.D. from an accredited law school.  

Attorney must be licensed to practice law and a member in good standing in the state/jurisdiction in which the position is based or otherwise in compliance with the in\-house counsel registration rules of that state/jurisdiction.
* Minimum 5\+ years of discovery experience at a financial services provider, consulting firm, discovery vendor, or top\-tier law firm, with cross\-EDRM hands\-on and advisory experience.
* Understanding of firm change management processes and procedures (SDLC, etc.) and experience working in a secure environment with sensitive data, including PII.
* Familiarity with Electronically Stored Information ESI investigation procedures, preservation, disposition, recovery, and analysis of data from a variety of electronic communication, voice, and unstructured systems (e.g., M365 Purview, MS Exchange, Connected Archive, Lotus Notes, Robocopy, OnTrack, Hard Drives, Ascent, Digital Safe, NICE, Cisco, SharePoint), backup tape infrastructure (ArcServe, TSM, TDP, NetBackup), structured data systems, databases and/or EDRM (eDiscovery Reference Model), or litigation support\-related experience.
* Project Management, ITIL, ACEDS, PMP background.
* Familiarity with, knowledge of, or understanding of legal chain\-of\-custody requirements, regulatory processes, and basic Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
* Self\-motivated, highly flexible, organized, and team\-oriented, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and manage confidential and/or sensitive, time\-critical, and competing priorities and projects. Comfortable responding to shifting priorities and working independently with minimal supervision.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses.
